implementation: Revoke direct client job inserts and review, membership and appointment mutations, including column grants.
Add restrictive policies so permissive legacy policies cannot reopen those write paths.
Preserve service-role API writes and existing reads.
Serialize active-owner removal using the parent organization row; reject deletion, demotion and reassignment of the last owner.
Reject manager removal of any owner through the members API.
Constrain attachment writes to the caller's own namespace or a job where the caller is homeowner, contractor or designated payer.
